svg.title: Your own week: the blank, and one filled in
svg.desc: Two ten-row tables. The left one is blank, with four yellow question-mark header cells for the learner to name and ten empty rows. The right one is filled in with day, sleep, screen and steps columns; one steps cell is a red NaN and every other step count is printed with a decimal point.
svg.text: Your own week: the blank, and one filled in
one hole in steps, so all the step counts grew a dot
